skill.name: image-to-video
skill.description: Routes still-image animation requests to HappyHorse, Wan 2.7, or Seedance 2.0 Pro, then runs the selected model through the local RunComfy CLI.
skill.summary: Choose and run a RunComfy image-to-video model for portraits, lip-sync, or multimodal animation.
skill.author: skills-collective

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are lexical false positives caused by Markdown backticks, URL placeholders, and documented configuration paths. The skill intentionally runs RunComfy CLI commands and installs external tooling, so those command findings remain confirmed at medium severity. It also sends prompts and user-supplied media URLs to RunComfy for remote processing.

remediation.issue: Prompts and referenced media are processed by RunComfy.
remediation.suggestion: Require user consent before submission and warn users not to send confidential, regulated, or unauthorized media.

remediation.issue: Examples place user-derived prompt text inside a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend structured argument execution or a validated input file so shell quoting remains correct for arbitrary prompt text.

remediation.issue: Installation commands fetch third-party tooling without a pinned version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed CLI and skill versions, and document package integrity verification for automated environments.

content.user_title: Animate Still Images with the Right RunComfy Model
content.value_statement: Choosing the wrong image-to-video model wastes time and generation credits. This skill routes each request to a suitable RunComfy model and supplies focused prompting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes general portrait, product, and ambient-audio animation to HappyHorse 1.0 I2V.
Routes custom voiceover lip-sync requests to Wan 2.7 using an audio URL.
Routes image, reference video, and reference audio compositions to Seedance 2.0 Pro.
Builds model-specific prompts focused on motion, camera, lighting, preservation, and reference numbering.
Invokes selected models with the local RunComfy CLI and downloads generated outputs.
Supports duration, resolution, aspect ratio, seed, watermark, and audio controls where each model allows them.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account or token, and network access.
Sends prompts and media URLs to RunComfy for remote processing.
Generates one model route per call and does not stitch outputs from multiple routes.
Model limits cap clips at 15 seconds; Seedance output is limited to 720p in this template.

use_cases.title: Animate Social Portraits
use_cases.description: Turn a portrait into a short clip with subtle motion, stable identity, and optional ambient audio.

use_cases.title: Produce Localized Voiceovers
use_cases.description: Create talking-head variants by pairing generated visuals with separate voiceover tracks for each language.

use_cases.title: Build Branded Multimodal Clips
use_cases.description: Combine a subject image, reference movement, and reference audio while preserving important brand details.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Portrait
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this portrait from {image_url}. Use subtle breathing, one blink, and a slow camera drift. Preserve identity and the background.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a simple portrait animation with the default model.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Reveal
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn {image_url} into a {duration}-second product reveal at {resolution}. Orbit slowly, preserve packaging text and geometry, and use clean studio lighting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a focused product motion clip.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Voiceover
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a {duration}-second {aspect_ratio} talking-head video using {audio_url}. Match lip movement to the voiceover. Use a locked camera and avoid subtitles or flicker.
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce a lip-synced presentation from custom audio.

prompt_templates.title: Compose Multimodal References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use {image_url} as the primary subject, {video_url} for scene motion, and {audio_url} for voice tone. Preserve identity and number each reference clearly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate subject, motion, and audio references in one clip.

output_examples.input: Animate this portrait with subtle breathing, one blink, and a slow camera drift.
output_examples.output: Selected HappyHorse 1.0 I2V and prepared a portrait-focused motion prompt with identity preservation.

output_examples.input: Create a vertical spokesperson clip that follows my twelve-second voiceover.
output_examples.output: Selected Wan 2.7 with the supplied audio, a twelve-second duration, and a vertical talking-head composition.

output_examples.input: Use my character image, cafe reference clip, and voice sample to create one scene.
output_examples.output: Selected Seedance 2.0 Pro and assigned the image, video, and audio as numbered references.

best_practices: Describe one primary motion per clip and place motion verbs early in the prompt.
State which identity, geometry, packaging, or background details must remain stable.
Match duration and aspect ratio to source media before submitting a paid generation.
anti_patterns: Do not restate every visible image detail when the prompt should describe motion and change.
Do not combine unrelated visual styles across image, video, and audio references.
Do not submit confidential or unauthorized media URLs to a third-party generation service.

faq.question: Does this skill require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate through the browser flow or a RunComfy token.

faq.question: Which image formats are supported?
faq.answer: HappyHorse accepts JPEG, JPG, PNG, and WebP images. Other model routes follow their documented media requirements.

faq.question: Can I use my own voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. The Wan 2.7 route accepts a remote WAV or MP3 file and uses it for lip synchronization.

faq.question: How does the skill choose a model?
faq.answer: It selects HappyHorse for general animation, Wan 2.7 for custom voiceovers, and Seedance for multiple media references.

faq.question: Can I change the output aspect ratio?
faq.answer: Wan and Seedance support aspect controls. HappyHorse keeps the source image aspect ratio.

faq.question: Where is my content processed?
faq.answer: RunComfy processes prompts and referenced media remotely. Generated outputs are then downloaded to the selected local directory.
